lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso; spacing is narrowest at the anterior (shoulder) region and widest at the posterior-midsection.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 7th and 8th lines (counting from anterior), merging approximately 10% below the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 1, 10, 11, and 12 exhibit significant discontinuity, terminating in segmented blobs or spots before reaching the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 to 8 high-contrast circular spots is localized on the posterior haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots on the lower haunch align to form a semi-connected diagonal geometric line directed towards the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced white chevron between the orbits and two distinct white spots on the lower cheek. High-contrast white horizontal bands are present on the lower forelimbs and hindlimbs.
